name: Close-grip push-up
description: Place your hands shoulder-width or narrower and lower with your elbows close to your body.

name: Overhead dumbbell extension
description: Hold one dumbbell overhead with both hands, lower it behind your head, then extend.

name: Bench dip
description: With your hands on a bench behind you, lower your body and press back up.

name: Rope pushdown
description: Push a cable rope down by straightening your elbows, keeping your upper arms still.

name: Skull crusher
description: Lying on a bench, lower the bar toward your forehead by bending your elbows, then extend.

name: Diamond push-up
description: Form a diamond with your index fingers and thumbs under your chest, then push up.
caution: Keep elbows close and wrists under shoulders to protect the wrists.

name: Band pushdown
description: Anchor a band overhead and push down by extending your elbows.

name: Dumbbell kickback
description: Hinge forward and extend one arm back, keeping your upper arm still.

name: Tricep dip on parallel bars
description: Support yourself on the bars and lower with your elbows pointing back, then press up.
caution: Shoulder strain risk. Keep the descent shallow if you feel pain at the front of the shoulder.

name: Overhead cable extension
description: Face away from the cable, hold the rope overhead, and extend your arms.
